summary: In this episode of the AWS Podcast, you'll hear how Cohere Health®, uses Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to optimize the accuracy and efficiency of health plan medical necessity reviews. Cohere Review Resolve™ analyzes both structured and unstructured data–such as clinical records, patient notes, and faxes, quickly identifying and surfacing evidence to validate the medical necessity of a requested treatment. Hear why Cohere Health chose Amazon Bedrock AgentCore for their production deployment of agentic AI in a highly regulated healthcare environment and how this integration in Review Resolve™ reduces review times helping them to meet critical, mandated turnaround times.
title: #754: Accelerating healthcare decisions with agents
